summary: DevGod now generates code-signal-derived route, service, integration, configuration, authentication, authorization, and runtime-side-effect inventory surfaces, and emits explicit ambiguity gaps instead of silently hiding dynamic discovery limits.
residual_risk: Rewrite and strategy gating still need to consume the richer inventory evidence before optimistic directives are fully blocked.
Runtime trace freshness and installed-repo realism remain later slices in the roadmap.
